sources.title: Hyundai Canada - Frequently Asked Questions (NACS and Supercharger access)
sources.notes: States IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9 (2026 model year onwards) have a NACS port; other CCS EVs incl. 2026 KONA Electric and Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier can use a NACS adapter sold separately. Does not name IONIQ 6 or IONIQ 5 N.

sources.title: Hyundai Canada - 2027 IONIQ 5 N
sources.notes: 2027 model-year page: 84 kWh battery, charge speed 238 kW on a 350 kW DCFC, 10-80% about 18 min, N-exclusive 21 in forged wheels, "Heat pump, battery thermal management and preconditioning system". No NACS/Supercharger wording.

sources.title: CarGurus - 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N pricing, specs, release date
sources.notes: US article: 2026 IONIQ 5 N has a standard NACS port (new for 2026), 84 kWh, standard 21 in forged wheels, 10-80% about 18 min.

sources.title: The Charge Port - NACS Port & Adapter Checker 2026
sources.notes: US-oriented: IONIQ 5 N 2025 and IONIQ 6 2025 use CCS1 and need an adapter (IONIQ 6 ended with MY2025); Kia EV6 2025-2026 has native NACS (GT excluded).

sources.title: The Charge Port - 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5
sources.notes: US-oriented: home charging up to 10.9 kW, native NACS on 2025+ models, 84 kWh on long-range trims. Does not state a DC peak.

sources.title: The Weekly Driver - Hyundai E-GMP 84 kWh battery
sources.notes: Lists the 84 kWh pack as 81 kWh usable, NCM 811 pouch cells from SK On, 697 V; used in 2025 IONIQ 5 Long Range/XRT, IONIQ 5 N and 2025 Kia EV6 Long Range. No primary source cited on the page.

sources.title: EV Database - Kia EV6 GT
sources.notes: 84.0 kWh nominal, 80.0 kWh usable (estimated), NMC cathode, 697 V nominal. GT only; same 84 kWh pack as other long-range EV6.

sources.title: EV Database - Hyundai IONIQ 6 Long Range AWD (MY23-25)
sources.notes: 77.4 kWh nominal, 74.0 kWh usable (conflicts with 72.6 already recorded), NMC cathode, 697 V nominal. European car.

sources.title: Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama - Hyundai debuts U.S.-built 2025 IONIQ 5 range, including XRT
sources.notes: US release: XRT has unique black 18 in wheels with 235/60R18 all-terrain tires, 84 kWh dual-motor AWD only, NACS port with CCS adapter.

sources.title: Kia US - 2026 EV6 specifications and trim comparison
sources.notes: US: Light 63 kWh, other trims 84 kWh; 10.9 kW onboard charger; NACS standard; 19 in alloy standard on Light/Wind/GT-Line (20 in optional on GT-Line AWD); range-preserving heat pump "Not available" on Light, "Available" on others. No DC peak kW.

sources.title: Green Car Reports - 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 6 cut real-world fast-charging time
sources.notes: 2023 IONIQ 6: Battery Conditioning starts when a DC fast charger is set as destination/waypoint; at that time no manual control.

sources.title: Hyundai Ireland - IONIQ 6 Features
sources.notes: European IONIQ 6: battery pre-conditioning can be started remotely via the Bluelink app or a button inside the car. Navigation trigger not mentioned on this page.
